title: P0.33: UiOnly launcher must spawn the local UI
description: Live proof showed start_iabv.ps1 -UiOnly wrote startup_attempt and mcp_tunnel_skipped but never emitted python_launch_attempt, leaving no IABV UI process. The script documentation says UiOnly is the daily shortcut mode, so UiOnly must imply StartUI before the launch block.
resume_hint: Completed in local Windows runtime. -UiOnly now sets $StartUI = $true before startup audit and autopull relaunch preserves -UiOnly and -AllowNonMain.
next_action: Launch IABV through the desktop shortcut or start_iabv.ps1 -UiOnly and verify startup_audit contains python_launch_attempt/python_launch_spawned followed by runtime_build_fingerprint.
reason: The universal loop cannot observe or remediate runtime failures if the birth path records startup audit but never creates the UI process. The daily one-window launcher must be a real birth path, not a no-op.
